entities.label: Person
entities.summary:
Xu You or Hsü Yu was a legendary Chinese recluse who lived during the reign of the Emperor Yao, residing next to the Ying River. The emperor allegedly offered him the royal throne towards the end of his rule.











 Xu You was a central figure in the development of Taoist philosophy, particularly in the teachings of the Zhuangzi text. His life and teachings emphasize the importance of non-action and the pursuit of a natural, effortless way of living.

















 Xu You's legacy can be seen in the many Taoist temples and shrines that still exist today, particularly in the Jiangxi province where he is believed to have lived. His teachings continue to inspire and influence Taoist thought and practice.
